items.source: use of PathMatcher and UrlPathHelper is deprecated for use at runtime in web modules in favor of parsed patterns with PathPatternParser.

items.source: Checks if any of the patterns match the given request and returns an instance that is guaranteed to contain matching patterns, sorted via PathMatcher.getPatternComparator(String).
items.translation: 检查是否有任何模式匹配给定的请求，并返回一个保证包含匹配模式的实例，该实例通过 PathMatcher.getPatternComparator(String) 排序。
